sourceObject.name: Cavalier
sourceObject.description: A chivalric mounted-warrior class with social qualifications, possible zero-level stages, and its own conduct code. The original table's hit-die heading conflicts with other text; errata must be identified separately.
guidance: Requires Strength, Dexterity, Constitution 15 and Intelligence, Wisdom 10; confirm service, social station, sponsorship, and any zero-level stages.
At each higher level, increase the Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution percentiles by the specified 2d10 procedure.
Below the self-training threshold, train with a cavalier of at least level 4 or two levels higher, whichever is greater.
After reaching level 6, the normal regimen suffices for training; mount and weapon abilities continue to change.
errata: Project-supplied correction: cavalier hit dice are d10. This correction is kept separate from the original printing’s conflicting hit-die heading. An authoritative errata document has not yet been checked in this release.

changes: A mounted lance is your first weapon of choice, at +1 to hit. These attack bonuses do not add damage or confer magical-weapon hit eligibility.
A weapon of choice uses the accelerated attack routine, counting as five levels higher; at first level this gives three attacks per two rounds rather than the ordinary one per round.
Apply the 2d10 percentile-increase procedure to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution. When a percentile score exceeds 100, raise the main score by 1 and subtract 100; the stated maximum is 18/00.
Mounted lance damage bonus increases +1 → +2; dismounted lance damage remains +1.
Saddle protection increases 85% → 86% against being thrown and against injury when a mount falls.
Choose broad sword, long sword, or scimitar as a weapon of choice, gaining +1 to hit with that weapon. These attack bonuses do not add damage or confer magical-weapon hit eligibility.
Apply the 2d10 percentile-increase procedure to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution. When a percentile score exceeds 100, raise the main score by 1 and subtract 100; the stated maximum is 18/00.
You may vault into the saddle in bulky armor and get underway in one segment.

Mounted lance damage bonus increases +3 → +4; dismounted lance damage remains +1.
Saddle protection increases 87% → 88% against being thrown and against injury when a mount falls.
You may fly a pennon on your lance in battle, with a duplicate marking your retainers’ position. Losing the battle flag brings dishonor and an obligation to regain it.

Choose horseman’s mace, horseman’s flail, or horseman’s military pick as a weapon of choice, gaining +1 to hit with that weapon. These attack bonuses do not add damage or confer magical-weapon hit eligibility.

sourceObject.name: Druid · UA high levels
sourceObject.description: UA extends the druid hierarchy through Grand Druid and a separate Hierophant progression. The XP reset makes a simple level-1 cumulative array unsuitable.
guidance: The Grand Druid is level 15, with at least 3,000,001 XP; the office carries special responsibilities and benefits.
After at least 3,500,001 XP, a Grand Druid may seek a successor and abdicate.
On entering the level-16 Hierophant path, the XP total resets to 1 and office-related bonus spells are relinquished.
Use the separate Hierophant table and planar abilities; do not extrapolate the PHB druid table.

changes: Grand Druid eligibility begins at 3,000,001 XP; the office knows six spells of each spell level and gains the stated extra six spell levels, subject to the unique office and service conditions.
After at least 3,500,001 XP as Grand Druid, find a successor and abdicate to enter the Hierophant path: reset XP to 1 and relinquish the office-related extra spell levels.
Spell-slot maxima stay at six per spell level; future advancement changes casting level and grants special powers instead of additional slots.
Gain immunity to natural animal/vegetable poisons (including monster poisons), but not mineral poisons or poison gas; gain 160 extra years of life and vigorous health.

You can alter appearance non-magically in 1 segment: height and weight up to 50% either way, apparent age from child to very old, and human/humanoid features; true seeing or similar perception can reveal it.

For elemental conjuring, UA replaces the earth results and supplies further tables. A roll equal to or below your level as a percentage selects the desired creature type; otherwise roll the appropriate result normally.
Druid casting level increases 16 → 17; daily slots remain six at each spell level 1–7. Extra longevity increases 160 → 170 years.
Gain hibernation/suspended animation without aging for up to the longevity period (170 years at this level).
Gain entry to the Elemental Plane of Earth at will; transfer takes 1 round. Planar entry also makes the environment natural to you, with no time limit for remaining.
Gain conjure water elemental once per day; use the UA conjuring procedure and result table.
Druid casting level increases 17 → 18; daily slots remain six at each spell level 1–7. Extra longevity increases 170 → 180 years.
Gain entry to the Elemental Plane of Fire under the Earth-entry procedure, including its 1-round transfer and survival benefits.
Gain conjure air elemental once per day.
Add 1 fixed hit point: the table changes accumulated hp from 15 hit dice +2 to 15 hit dice +3.
Druid casting level increases 18 → 19; daily slots remain six at each spell level 1–7. Extra longevity increases 180 → 190 years.
Gain entry to the Elemental Plane of Water under the Earth-entry procedure, including its 1-round transfer and survival benefits.
Gain the listed magma/smoke para-elemental conjuring ability once per day.
Druid casting level increases 19 → 20; daily slots remain six at each spell level 1–7. Extra longevity increases 190 → 200 years.
Gain entry to the Elemental Plane of Air under the Earth-entry procedure, including its 1-round transfer and survival benefits.
Gain the listed ice/ooze para-elemental conjuring ability once per day.
Druid casting level increases 20 → 21; daily slots remain six at each spell level 1–7. Extra longevity increases 200 → 210 years.
Gain entry to the Para-Elemental Planes. The general entry rule makes the destination environment natural to you, with no time limit for remaining.
Druid casting level increases 21 → 22; daily slots remain six at each spell level 1–7. Extra longevity increases 210 → 220 years.
Gain entry to the Plane of Shadow. The general entry rule makes the destination environment natural to you, with no time limit for remaining.
Druid casting level increases 22 → 23; daily slots remain six at each spell level 1–7. Extra longevity increases 220 → 230 years.
Gain access to any Inner Plane, Inner Plane Probability Lines (the seventh dimension), and the Plane of Concordant Opposition under the Earth-entry procedure.
Add 1 fixed hit point: the table changes accumulated hp from 15 hit dice +7 to 15 hit dice +8.
